div.p: Information Trapped in Chat Threads: Critical project changes, client instructions, and vendor updates stay buried inside isolated WhatsApp chats and personal email inboxes.
Loss of Important Context: Key decisions and agreements vanish the second a conversation ends, leaving your team out of the loop and guessing what's next.
Wasted Time Hunting Messages: Without a single shared record, managers waste hours digging through old messages whenever a delivery dispute or mistake happens.
Unnoticed Scope & Price Shifts: Critical changes to freight rates, MOQs, or shipping dates get buried in unread messages, leading to surprise charges at the port.

div.style: border: 1px solid transparent; background: linear-gradient(#fff, #fff) padding-box, linear-gradient(90deg, #4262ae 35.577%, #64beb5 75.481%, #53b973 100%) border-box;

div.p: One Single Timeline: SummaFlow automatically pulls updates from your emails and WhatsApp chats into one organized, up-to-date project timeline.
Catch Delays Early: Automatically spots price changes, missed dates, and open questions before they turn into costly mistakes.
100% Verifiable: Every update links directly back to the original message, sender, and timestamp so you always have proof.
Instant Change Notifications: Get flagged immediately when a supplier or carrier shifts a quote, pushes back an ETA, or attaches a revised compliance file mid-conversation.

h2.span: Traditional Operational Workflow vs. SummaFlow Intelligence

tr.td: Hours spent copying quotes, ETAs, and MOQs into manual Excel tracking sheets.

✓ Zero Manual Entry
Facts are automatically extracted into structured ledgers as conversations happen.
Digging through 50+ email threads and WhatsApp groups to verify a single price update.

✓ 1-Click Traceability 
Every extracted figure links directly back to the original source message and timestamp.
Pasting sensitive client or supplier communications into unsecure, third-party AI tools.

✓ Ephemeral RAM Processing
Raw text is scanned transiently; non-relevant messages are dropped and never saved.
Missing supplier holds, compliance document gaps, or margin shifts buried deep in inbox threads.

✓ Automated Risk Isolation: 
Surfaces shipment holds, document gaps, and margin shifts before delays occur.
Hours spent briefing covering agents or forwarding endless message chains during shift handovers.

✓ Shared Live Ledger
Centralized project timelines allow anyone on the team to get full context in seconds.

div.p: Raw email and WhatsApp text is evaluated transiently in volatile memory (RAM) and immediately destroyed. Non-relevant messages are never saved to physical disk or databases.

i.class: fa fa-user-plus s_features_icon mb-3 bg-o-color-3 text-o-color-5 rounded

div.p: Access operates strictly through standard provider permissions (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365). You maintain total control and can disconnect any integration instantly from your settings.

i.class: fa fa-database s_features_icon mb-3 bg-o-color-3 text-o-color-5 rounded

div.p: SummaFlow never invents data. Every extracted figure, ETA, and price revision remains permanently anchored to its exact source timestamp, channel, and sender for 1-click verification.

i.class: fa fa-check-square s_features_icon mb-3 bg-o-color-3 text-o-color-5 rounded

div.p: Automated PII (Personally Identifiable Information) scrubbers sanitise sensitive personal details prior to processing, strictly conforming to regional privacy laws including the Hong Kong PDPO.

p.span: How do you extract action items from WhatsApp and Emails without changing our team's communication workflows?

div.p: SummaFlow works as a zero-install integration that connects directly to Gmail, Outlook, and WhatsApp Business API. Your team continues communicating normally on their preferred messaging apps. Our AI background parser automatically processes background text, routes conversational updates to the correct project workspace, and converts unstructured chat data into structured, action-oriented project logs without requiring manual data entry or team onboarding.

p.span: What is the technical onboarding timeline for operations teams?

div.p: The complete technical onboarding timeline for SummaFlow is under two minutes. Workspace administrators simply authorise their communications infrastructure using industry-standard, secure OAuth protocols for Microsoft 365, Google Workspace,  WhatsApp and Line channels. There is no custom codebase integration, local software deployment, or technical overhead required to go live.

button.class: accordion-header accordion-button gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none justify-content-between collapsed

p.span: What is the mechanism behind SummaFlow’s zero-hallucination project timeline?

div.p: We eliminate AI hallucinations by using a deterministic, source-anchored data-extraction model. Every summarized decision, risk, and next step generated by SummaFlow features a secure, unalterable backlink pointing directly to the exact source email or chat timestamp. If a team member or auditor needs to verify a timeline entry, they click the link to inspect the original text, ensuring absolute operational data integrity and verification.
